name: Volumetric-Primitives Path Tracer
definition: A forward rendering method for scattering and emissive media that models the scene as a collection of 3D kernel-based volumetric primitives and uses ray tracing to compute light transport, supporting multiple scattering via Next-Event Estimation.
summary: Volumetric-Primitives Path Tracer is a forward rendering method that models scenes as 3D kernel-based primitives, using closed-form analytical solutions to eliminate Monte Carlo noise and enable efficient hardware-accelerated traversal.
